title: LangSmith (LangChain) API key (personal access token or service key): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: The _ separator between the 32- and 10-character segments is removed, so the value no longer has the two-segment layout; characters are otherwise unchanged. Twin of "LangSmith (LangChain) API key (personal access token or service key): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
